introHtml: Men's nursing scrubs are cut with broader shoulders and longer torsos for a professional fit that moves with you. Unlike unisex styles, these scrubs offer reinforced side seams and deeper pockets for carrying scissors, pens, and a phone during a shift. Choose a midweight cotton-poly blend or performance stretch fabric with your facility logo embroidered on the chest or sleeve. Bulk pricing makes them a smart choice for hospitals and clinics outfitting their entire team.
